slides.title: Speaking: photos and role plays
slides.subtitle: Expresión oral: describir fotos y juegos de rol

head: Paso
Frases
rows: In this photo I can see… / This is a picture of…
In the foreground / background… On the left / right…
A man is… They are wearing…
They might be friends. It looks like a party.
I think they are happy because…

items.en: In this photo I can see a family in a park.
On the left, a man is cooking on a grill.
In the background, two children are playing football.
It looks like a sunny day. I think they are having a good time.

slides.title: Situación y frase
pairs: Do you have something for a headache?
I have a reservation under the name Ruiz.
A return ticket to León, please.
Could we see the menu, please?

slides.title: Tu turno
body: Busca una foto en tu celular y descríbela en voz alta durante 1 minuto usando los 5 pasos. Grábate y revisa:
list: ☐ ¿Usé *there is / there are* y presente continuo?
